description_en: For sale - 2+1 apartment in Ulsuga The apartment is located in the Ulsuga Complex, just 7 minutes from Skenderbej Square. It is located on the 7th floor, with an elevator. Total area 110 m2. There are 2 bedrooms, a living room, 2 bathrooms and a balcony. Investment and high-quality furniture: Floored with parquet, double-glazed windows, toilets are made of Porcelanosa. Sold furnished.
